title: Data Analyst
description:
Data Analyst

London (Hybrid) | Up to £47,000


Looking for a role where your analysis directly influences business strategy and customer engagement? This is an exciting opportunity to join a well-established organisation that places data and audience insight at the heart of decision-making. You'll work across customer, digital and commercial data to uncover actionable insights, optimise performance and help shape future growth.


The Company

They are a recognised organisation with a strong customer focus and a significant digital presence, serving a large and diverse audience across multiple channels. Data and insight play a critical role in driving commercial performance, customer engagement and strategic decision-making. Their collaborative environment brings together analytics, marketing, digital and commercial teams to solve complex business challenges and deliver meaningful outcomes.


The Role

You will be responsible for delivering high-quality reporting, dashboarding and audience insight across membership, customer engagement, digital performance and commercial activity. Key responsibilities include:

  • Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and business intelligence reporting.
  • Use SQL to analyse large, complex datasets and generate actionable insights.
  • Deliver analysis on customer behaviour, membership performance and commercial trends.
  • Integrate digital analytics data, including GA4, with broader business reporting.
  • Support stakeholders with ad hoc analysis, reporting and data-driven recommendations.
  • Partner with marketing, digital and commercial teams to improve performance and customer journeys.
  • Design and evaluate CRM and campaign testing activity.
  • Present findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Maintain documentation, KPI definitions and reporting standards.

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong SQL experience for reporting and data analysis.
  • Experience building dashboards and reports using Power BI.
  • Advanced Excel skills and a strong understanding of data structures.
  • Ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations.
  • Experience working with customer, marketing or audience data.
  • Knowledge of GA4, web analytics or digital performance reporting is advantageous.
  • Exposure to Python or other analytical programming languages is beneficial.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • A proactive, curious mindset with strong attention to detail.


How to Apply

If you're a data-driven professional who enjoys turning complex information into meaningful business insight, apply today to learn more about this exciting Data Analyst opportunity.
